# K1 — standards (STD) under .claude/rules/<scope>/

@@ output/template/.claude/rules/common/security.md ;; Path-scoped (all files).
@scope path-scoped: **/* (all code and configuration)
1-4 IM ;; Frontmatter path scope.
6 NN ;; Banner (kind, scope, capability, loading metadata).
8 NN ;; Heading.
10 NN ;; Heading.
12 OL [sec001.no-secrets]
13 OL [sec002.secret-mechanisms]
15 NN ;; Heading.
17 OL [sec003.untrusted-input]
18 OL [sec005.server-authz]
20 NN ;; Heading.
22 OL [sec007.tls]
23 OL [sec007.no-cert-disable]
25 NN ;; Heading.
27 OL [sec010.no-sensitive-logs]
28 OL [run014.no-payload-logs]
30 NN ;; Heading.
32 OL [sec013.fail-safe]
33 OL [sec014.fail-visibly]
35 IM ;; Related routing pointers (add-dependency, security-scan).

C sec001.no-secrets OL SEC-001 MUST_NOT ;; Never hardcode or commit real secrets, credentials, private keys, access/refresh tokens or production connection strings, including in example configuration files. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec002.secret-mechanisms OL SEC-002 DEFAULT ;; Local secret mechanism (dotnet user-secrets) for development and environment-specific injection or a managed secret store when deployed; do not assume an unchosen cloud provider. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec003.untrusted-input OL SEC-003 MUST ;; Data crossing the trusted boundary (requests, uploads, external responses, message payloads, user-provided identifiers/filters) is untrusted and validated at the owning layer when assumptions matter. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec005.server-authz OL SEC-005 MUST ;; Authorization is enforced on the server; route guards, hidden/disabled UI actions and client checks are UX, not a security boundary. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec007.tls OL SEC-007 MUST ;; Production traffic carrying credentials or sensitive data uses TLS, respecting the hosting topology (in-app redirection not required where the deployment provides the boundary and redirection is not desired). ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec007.no-cert-disable OL SEC-007 MUST_NOT ;; Never disable certificate validation to make an integration work. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec010.no-sensitive-logs OL SEC-010 MUST_NOT ;; Never log passwords, tokens, private keys, authentication secrets or full payment credentials; avoid PII without a concrete permitted operational need; a lower log level does not make sensitive data safe; prefer stable technical identifiers. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run014.no-payload-logs OL RUN-014 MUST_NOT ;; Do not serialize arbitrary request bodies, domain objects or sensitive payloads into logs by default; log minimal useful non-sensitive context. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec013.fail-safe OL SEC-013 DEFAULT ;; Security-sensitive authorization, permission and required-control checks fail safely; never silently convert a lookup or configuration failure into success. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec014.fail-visibly OL SEC-014 MUST ;; A required security control that cannot be configured correctly fails visibly at startup/configuration time instead of falling back to an insecure mode. ;; = ;; none ;;

@@ output/template/.claude/rules/backend/architecture.md ;; Path-scoped (backend).
@scope path-scoped: backend/**/*
1-4 IM ;; Frontmatter path scope.
6 NN ;; Banner (kind, scope, capability, loading metadata).
8 NN ;; Heading.
10 NN ;; Descriptive applicability statement with pointer to the frame style rules.
12 NN ;; Heading.
14 OL [arc010.thin-controllers]
15 OL [arc011.controller-no-logic]
17 NN ;; Heading.
19 OL [arc021.ctor-injection]
20 OL [arc022.lifetimes]
22 NN ;; Heading.
24 OL [arc024.cache-boundary]
25 OL [arc025.no-transport-leak]
27 IM ;; Technique pointers.

C arc010.thin-controllers OL ARC-010 MUST ;; ASP.NET Core Controllers are the default HTTP entry point and stay thin: bind and validate input, invoke Application services, translate outcomes into HTTP responses. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc011.controller-no-logic OL ARC-011 MUST_NOT ;; Controllers contain no business logic, do not access the database context or concrete repositories and do not construct infrastructure services manually. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc021.ctor-injection OL ARC-021 DEFAULT ;; Constructor injection for required dependencies; avoid service-locator and property injection. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc022.lifetimes OL ARC-022 MUST ;; Dependency lifetimes are valid; never capture a shorter-lived dependency in a longer-lived service. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc024.cache-boundary OL ARC-024 MUST ;; Cache technology stays out of Domain; infrastructure cache APIs do not leak into Application without a deliberate boundary abstraction. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc025.no-transport-leak OL ARC-025 MUST ;; Infrastructure translates remote HTTP responses into Application-facing abstractions; HttpResponseMessage and transport concerns never leak into Application. ;; = ;; none ;;

14-17 OL [arc001.role-map]

21 OL [arc001.inward]

27 OL [arc003.simple-entities]

29 OL [arc005.no-ddd-theater]

32 NN ;; Heading.

C arc001.role-map OL ARC-001,DEP-024 DECIDED ;; Role map: Domain (backend/<Name>.Domain, business concepts independent of infrastructure and transport), Application (use-case orchestration and abstractions), Infrastructure (implementations of Application abstractions), Api (HTTP entry point and composition root). ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc001.inward OL ARC-001,ARC-008 MUST ;; Dependencies point inward (Domain none; Application→Domain; Infrastructure→Application, Domain; Api→Application and Infrastructure only for composition/registration); inner layers never depend on outer layers or Infrastructure-specific types. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc001.reconsider OL ARC-001 MUST ;; If a feature seems to need an outward reference, reconsider the abstraction boundary instead of adding it. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc002.domain-independent OL ARC-002 MUST ;; Domain stays independent of the persistence technology, ASP.NET Core, HTTP and external-service implementation concerns. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc003.simple-entities OL ARC-003 DEFAULT ;; Simple domain entities; straightforward CRUD and workflow rules (validation, immutable fields, status transitions, edit rules) belong in Application Services and do not justify a richer model. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc004.rich-domain-approval OL ARC-004 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Move behaviour into Domain only for non-trivial invariants materially benefiting from encapsulation; otherwise Rich Domain/DDD tactical patterns require approval unless the specification requires them. ;; = ;; Approved specification requires the design. ;;
C arc005.no-ddd-theater OL ARC-005 MUST_NOT ;; No factories, private setters, transition methods, Aggregate Roots, Domain Events, Specifications, Domain Services, systematic Value Objects or similar merely to look domain-driven. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc013.aggregate-boundary OL ARC-013 DEFINITION ;; In an approved DDD design Aggregate Roots are the natural repository-boundary candidates. ;; = ;; Approved DDD design. ;;
C arc006.app-services OL ARC-006 DEFAULT ;; Application Services orchestrate use cases (Domain objects, repositories, external abstractions, Unit of Work); a large service signals reconsidering responsibilities, not another pattern. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc007.abstractions OL ARC-007 MUST ;; Application defines the persistence and external-service abstractions its use cases require and keeps infrastructure details out. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc008.app-no-tech OL ARC-008,ARC-019 MUST_NOT ;; Application must not depend on persistence-technology types or APIs (database context, entity sets, query/provider types) or ASP.NET Core transport types. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc016.uow OL ARC-016 DEFAULT ;; IUnitOfWork is the use-case commit boundary; repositories stage changes and Application Services decide when to commit. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc017.shared-uow OL ARC-017 MUST ;; Repositories in one use case share the same scoped Unit of Work and persistence context, are injected explicitly, and IUnitOfWork never becomes a repository container or service locator. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc012.composition-root OL ARC-012 DEFAULT ;; Program.cs in Api is the composition root and may register Infrastructure implementations. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc023.registration OL ARC-023 DEFAULT ;; Registration stays near the owning layer (AddApplication, AddInfrastructure(configuration)); Api composes them. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc029.no-dup-dto OL ARC-029 MUST_NOT ;; Do not duplicate equivalent DTOs across Api and Application merely for layer-shaped types; transport-specific contracts in Api when separation gives a concrete boundary benefit. ;; = ;; none ;;

@@ output/template/.claude/rules/backend/persistence.md ;; Path-scoped (backend).
@scope path-scoped: backend/**/*
1-4 IM ;; Frontmatter path scope.
6 NN ;; Banner (kind, scope, capability, loading metadata).
8 NN ;; Heading.
10 NN ;; Pointer to the technology-specific persistence rules.
12 NN ;; Heading.
14 OL [arc013.specific-repos]
15 OL [arc014.no-iqueryable]
16 OL [arc015.no-generic-repo]
18 NN ;; Heading.
20 OL [sec004.parameterized]
22 NN ;; Heading.
24 OL [pst001.seed-default]
25 OL [pst004.dev-only]
26 OL [pst006.leave-existing]
27 OL [pst007.valid-seed]
29 IM ;; Procedure pointer (persistence-change).

C arc013.specific-repos OL ARC-013 DEFAULT ;; Specific repository interfaces for cohesive Application persistence needs, defined in Application and implemented in Infrastructure, not table-mirroring generic CRUD. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc014.no-iqueryable OL ARC-014 MUST_NOT ;; Repository interfaces never expose IQueryable<T>, database-context or entity-set types, query expressions or provider types; return materialized entities, collections, projections or result models. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc015.no-generic-repo OL ARC-015 MUST_NOT ;; Application must not depend on IGenericRepository<T> or another generic CRUD contract; a generic base only as an Infrastructure detail removing real duplication. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec004.parameterized OL SEC-004 MUST ;; Database access is parameterized (raw SQL, micro-ORMs, ADO.NET included); never build SQL by concatenating untrusted input. ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst001.seed-default OL PST-001 DEFAULT ;; An empty Development database receives a small deterministic representative seed dataset covering meaningful states and relationships. ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst004.dev-only OL PST-004 MUST_NOT ;; Automatic seeding runs only in Development, never Production; the development seeder is not test setup; tests own their setup. ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst006.leave-existing OL PST-006 MUST_NOT ;; When representative data exists leave it unchanged; never use the seeder to synchronize, repair, upgrade, overwrite or recreate an existing Development database; developers recreate explicitly. ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst007.valid-seed OL PST-007 MUST ;; Seed entities preserve Domain invariants and valid relationships; prefer readable deterministic examples over exhaustive or random combinations. ;; = ;; none ;;

C arc019.ef-boundary OL ARC-019,ARC-008 MUST ;; EF Core is an Infrastructure detail used fully there; DbContext, DbSet<T>, EF Core APIs, EF-backed IQueryable<T> and provider types never leak into Application. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc016.uow-impl OL ARC-016,ARC-017 MUST ;; Infrastructure implements IUnitOfWork by delegating to the shared scoped AppDbContext. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc018.no-tx OL ARC-018 DEFAULT ;; No explicit transaction APIs until a concrete use case needs control beyond a single SaveChangesAsync. ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst002.seed-infra OL PST-002 MUST ;; Development seeding is an Infrastructure/bootstrap concern and may use AppDbContext directly without repositories or IUnitOfWork. ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst003.seeder-location OL PST-003 MUST ;; Substantial seed construction lives in a dedicated internal DbSeeder (Persistence/Seeding/) behind a narrow Infrastructure initialization extension, never in Program.cs, AppDbContext configuration, entity configurations or migrations. ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst005.no-migrate OL PST-005 MUST_NOT ;; The development seeder must not call Database.Migrate()/EnsureCreated() or otherwise create/upgrade schema; migrations are applied separately before seeding. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep026.dev-connection OL DEP-026,SEC-001 DEFAULT ;; appsettings.Development.json provides a usable local connection string when it holds no secret credentials; credential-bearing values come from user-secrets or another approved local mechanism. ;; = ;; none ;;

@@ output/template/.claude/rules/backend/api.md ;; Path-scoped (backend).
@scope path-scoped: backend/**/*
1-4 IM ;; Frontmatter path scope.
6 NN ;; Banner (kind, scope, capability, loading metadata).
8 NN ;; Heading.
10 NN ;; Heading.
12 OL [api001.transport-owner]
13 OL [api003.status-semantics]
14 OL [api004.empty-collection]
15 OL [api005.401-403]
16 OL [api006.409-412]
18 NN ;; Heading.
20 OL [api002.problem-details]
21 OL [api007.central-handler]
22 OL [api008.no-exposure]
23 OL [api012.log-once]
24 OL [api021.cancellation]
26 NN ;; Heading.
28 OL [api009.expected-outcomes]
29 OL [api010.validation-boundaries]
30 OL [api011.no-business-exceptions]
32 IM ;; Technique pointers.

C api001.transport-owner OL API-001 MUST ;; HTTP status codes and transport semantics belong to the Api layer; Application/Domain never return IActionResult or ASP.NET Core status codes. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api003.status-semantics OL API-003 MUST ;; Success statuses follow HTTP semantics: never 200 for every outcome, 201 for an internal insert or 202 for completed work. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api004.empty-collection OL API-004 DEFAULT ;; A successful zero-match collection query returns 200 with an empty collection, not 404. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api005.401-403 OL API-005 MUST ;; 401 for missing/failed authentication, 403 for a non-permitted principal; 404 hiding requires a deliberate consistent security policy. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api006.409-412 OL API-006 MUST ;; 409 for valid requests conflicting with current state; 412 when an explicit HTTP precondition such as If-Match fails. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api002.problem-details OL API-002 DEFAULT ;; ProblemDetails for non-validation failures and ValidationProblemDetails for request validation; machine-readable contracts stable and safe. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api007.central-handler OL API-007 DEFAULT ;; Unexpected failures propagate to centralized IExceptionHandler handling; avoid repetitive catch/log/rethrow. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api008.no-exposure OL API-008 MUST_NOT ;; Never expose stack traces, SQL, connection strings, internal paths, secrets or sensitive exception details in public API errors. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api012.log-once OL API-012 MUST ;; Log an unexpected exception once at the handling boundary; never again across repository, Application, controller and global handler. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api021.cancellation OL API-021 MUST_NOT ;; Normal client-request cancellation is not mapped to a generic 500 or logged as an unhandled failure. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api009.expected-outcomes OL API-009 DEFAULT ;; Represent expected outcomes explicitly when useful (null, bool, typed outcome); no forced Result<T>; no HTTP-named outcome categories in Application. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api010.validation-boundaries OL API-010 MUST ;; FluentValidation for explicit request/use-case validation where appropriate; validation at its owning boundary (Api transport, Application use-case rules, Domain invariants, Infrastructure external assumptions); no mechanical duplication across layers. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api011.no-business-exceptions OL API-011 MUST_NOT ;; Business exceptions are not the default architecture; never throw/catch merely to jump between expected branches. ;; = ;; none ;;

@@ output/template/.claude/rules/backend/api-contracts.md ;; Path-scoped (backend).
@scope path-scoped: backend/**/*
1-4 IM ;; Frontmatter path scope.
6 NN ;; Banner (kind, scope, capability, loading metadata).
8 NN ;; Heading.
10 NN ;; Heading.
12 OL [api013.versioning-need]
13 OL [api014.no-silent-break]
14 OL [api015.one-strategy]
15 OL [arc026.no-version-models]
17 NN ;; Heading.
19 OL [api016.swagger-accurate]
20 OL [api017.swagger-dev]
22 IM ;; Technique and procedure pointers.

C api013.versioning-need OL API-013 MUST_NOT ;; Must not introduce API versioning merely because an API exists; only for published compatibility or coexisting client generations (adopting it is Reserved). ;; = ;; none ;;
C api014.no-silent-break OL API-014 MUST_NOT ;; A version relied on by external clients must not change incompatibly in silence; a breaking change needs a new version or an explicitly approved compatibility strategy. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api015.one-strategy OL API-015 DEFAULT ;; When explicit versioning is required use one strategy consistently, URL-segment unless requirements justify another. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc026.no-version-models OL ARC-026 MUST_NOT ;; No separate Domain or persistence models merely because the external API has multiple versions; isolate version-specific transport contracts at the Api boundary. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api016.swagger-accurate OL API-016 MUST ;; Swagger/OpenAPI metadata describes the running API (routes, important statuses, schemas, authentication) and never speculative responses. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api017.swagger-dev OL API-017 DEFAULT ;; Swagger UI enabled in Development and exposed elsewhere only when a deployment requirement explicitly justifies it. ;; = ;; none ;;

C api018.cheap-health OL API-018 MUST ;; Health checks stay cheap and deterministic, never business workflows or expensive/mutating database work. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api019.liveness-readiness OL API-019 MUST ;; Liveness avoids external dependencies whose unavailability could cause restart loops; readiness may depend on required capabilities and must reflect startup and dependency availability. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api020.no-health-leak OL API-020 MUST_NOT ;; Publicly reachable health responses never expose secrets, credentials, connection details, stack traces or unnecessary diagnostics. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run013.structured-logging OL RUN-013 DEFAULT ;; ILogger<T> with structured templates and stable property names; avoid interpolation that makes structured values opaque. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep021.add-serilog OL DEP-021 DEFAULT ;; When Serilog is configured use DI-integrated AddSerilog with environment-aware provider configuration; application code depends on ILogger<T>. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run022.typed-options OL RUN-022 DEFAULT ;; Strongly typed options validated at startup when missing/invalid values prevent correct or secure operation; avoid scattered string-based IConfiguration lookups. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep019.runtime-image OL DEP-019 DEFAULT ;; Production containers use an appropriate runtime image, not the SDK image for convenience, and do not switch to root to bypass filesystem problems. ;; = ;; none ;;

@@ output/template/.claude/rules/backend/security.md ;; Path-scoped (backend).
@scope path-scoped: backend/**/*
1-4 IM ;; Frontmatter path scope.
6 NN ;; Banner (kind, scope, capability, loading metadata).
8 NN ;; Heading.
10 NN ;; Heading.
12 OL [sec006.anonymous-visible]
13 OL [sec016.no-custom-auth]
14 OL [sec017.token-validation]
15 OL [sec018.no-enumeration]
17 NN ;; Heading.
19 OL [sec008.no-custom-crypto]
21 NN ;; Heading.
23 OL [sec009.cors]
24 OL [sec015.upload-metadata]
26 IM ;; Technique and audit pointers.

C sec006.anonymous-visible OL SEC-006 MUST ;; Anonymous access is deliberate and visible; avoid redundant authorization attributes when a secure global or fallback policy expresses the intent. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec016.no-custom-auth OL SEC-016 MUST_NOT ;; No custom token/password security, password hashing or reset-token cryptography when ASP.NET Core authentication/Identity covers the requirement. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec017.token-validation OL SEC-017 MUST ;; Bearer/OIDC validates what the issuer/provider requires (issuer, audience where applicable, signature/signing authority, lifetime); never disable validation to make a token work. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec018.no-enumeration OL SEC-018 MUST_NOT ;; Authentication failures never reveal secrets or account state unnecessarily; login avoids account-enumeration leaks where relevant. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec008.no-custom-crypto OL SEC-008 MUST_NOT ;; No custom cryptography when a reviewed platform mechanism fits; Data Protection is not universal database encryption. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec009.cors OL SEC-009 DEFAULT ;; Narrowest CORS policy for actual browser clients (a public unauthenticated API may differ); never credentialed cross-origin requests with unrestricted origins. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec015.upload-metadata OL SEC-015 MUST_NOT ;; Never treat client-provided file metadata such as MIME type as authoritative when handling or security depends on actual content. ;; = ;; none ;;

@@ output/template/.claude/rules/backend/runtime.md ;; Path-scoped (backend).
@scope path-scoped: backend/**/*
1-4 IM ;; Frontmatter path scope.
6 NN ;; Banner (kind, scope, capability, loading metadata).
8 NN ;; Heading.
10 NN ;; Heading.
12 OL [run001.clear-first]
13 OL [run008.measured-optimizations]
15 NN ;; Heading.
17 OL [run002.async-io]
18 OL [run003.cancellation-token]
19 OL [run004.timeprovider]
21 NN ;; Heading.
23 OL [run006.db-efficiency]
25 NN ;; Heading.
27 OL [run005.httpclient-lifetime]
28 OL [run015.bounded-time]
29 OL [run016.safe-retry]
30 OL [run017.retry-after]
31 OL [run018.fallback]
32 OL [run019.cancellation-not-transient]
34 NN ;; Heading.
36 OL [run007.cache-need]
37 OL [run020.cache-keys]
38 OL [run023.cache-lifetime]
39 OL [run021.cache-invalidation]
41 IM ;; Technique and procedure pointers.

C run001.clear-first OL RUN-001 DEFAULT ;; Clear correct code first; no specialized optimization without a concrete reason; measurement/profiling evidence for non-trivial optimizations. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run008.measured-optimizations OL RUN-008 DEFAULT ;; Compiled queries, ValueTask, pooling, custom serialization, aggressive caching and raw SQL for performance only for a measured or clearly demonstrated need. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run002.async-io OL RUN-002 MUST ;; Use async APIs for asynchronous I/O; never block with .Result, .Wait() or similar. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run003.cancellation-token OL RUN-003 MUST ;; Propagate CancellationToken when cancellation is meaningful; no cancellation parameters on purely synchronous code without a use case. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run004.timeprovider OL RUN-004 DEFAULT ;; TimeProvider for clock-dependent logic needing deterministic tests; no mechanical replacement of explicit or stored timestamps. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run006.db-efficiency OL RUN-006 DEFAULT ;; Filter and project in the database when practical; avoid unnecessary round trips, over-fetching and N+1; paginate potentially large results. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run005.httpclient-lifetime OL RUN-005 MUST_NOT ;; Never create and dispose an HttpClient per request; use IHttpClientFactory or another long-lived strategy. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run015.bounded-time OL RUN-015 MUST ;; External I/O calls have bounded execution time; avoid overlapping timeout mechanisms with unclear combined behaviour. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run016.safe-retry OL RUN-016 MUST ;; Retry only when repetition is safe; never automatically retry state-changing operations without idempotency or another concrete safety mechanism. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run017.retry-after OL RUN-017 DEFAULT ;; Respect Retry-After or equivalent rate-limit guidance where appropriate; never retry indefinitely or aggressively. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run018.fallback OL RUN-018 MUST ;; Use a fallback only when semantically acceptable; never hide correctness failures behind convenient defaults. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run019.cancellation-not-transient OL RUN-019 MUST_NOT ;; Caller cancellation is not a transient failure: never retry it or turn it into repeated outbound attempts. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run007.cache-need OL RUN-007 DEFAULT ;; No caching without a clear measured or reasoned need; choose the implementation by deployment, consistency and staleness requirements. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run020.cache-keys OL RUN-020 MUST ;; Cache keys uniquely represent the value including user, tenant and context dimensions; no global keys for user- or tenant-specific data. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run023.cache-lifetime OL RUN-023 MUST ;; Every cache entry has a lifetime or another explicit invalidation strategy. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run021.cache-invalidation OL RUN-021 MUST ;; Invalidate/update cache entries only consistently with successful mutations; the cache never becomes a second source of truth. ;; = ;; none ;;

11 OL [run024.file-conventions]
12 OL [run011.no-style-rewrites]
14 IM ;; Technique and changed-file cleanup pointers.

C run009.conventions OL RUN-009 DEFAULT ;; Follow existing conventions and .editorconfig; modern C# when it improves clarity; do not rewrite working code solely for newer syntax. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run024.file-conventions OL RUN-024 DEFAULT ;; New C# code: file-scoped namespaces when consistent; one primary top-level type per matching file; Async suffix on Task/ValueTask methods unless a contract makes it inappropriate. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run011.no-style-rewrites OL RUN-011 MUST_NOT ;; No style-only rewrites outside the requested change unless explicitly asked; avoid mixing large formatting/modernization with functional work. ;; = ;; none ;;

8 NN ;; Heading.
10 OL [tst001.nunit]
12 IM ;; Technique and enforced-by pointers.

C tst001.nunit OL TST-001 DEFAULT ;; NUnit is the default .NET test framework; an established project deliberately using another follows it; no second framework without a concrete reason. ;; = ;; Established project framework. ;;

@@ output/template/.claude/rules/backend-tests/test-projects.md ;; Path-scoped (backend tests); architecture facet (clean-architecture).
@scope path-scoped: backend test projects
1-4 IM ;; Frontmatter path scope.
6 NN ;; Banner (kind, scope, capability, loading metadata).
8 NN ;; Heading.
10 OL [arc028.test-refs]
12-13 NN ;; Table header.
14-17 OL [arc028.typical-refs]
19 IM ;; Placement and enforced-by pointers.

C arc028.test-refs OL ARC-028 MUST_NOT ;; Backend test projects never have broader production references than their test scope requires and follow the inward dependency discipline. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc028.typical-refs OL ARC-028,TST-006 DEFAULT ;; Typical references: Domain.Tests (optional) → Domain; Application.Tests → Application (Domain as needed); IntegrationTests → Api (other layers through the host); Infrastructure.Tests (optional) → Infrastructure and narrower references as required. ;; = ;; none ;;

@@ output/template/.claude/rules/backend-tests/testing.md ;; Path-scoped (backend tests).
@scope path-scoped: backend test projects
1-4 IM ;; Frontmatter path scope.
6 NN ;; Banner (kind, scope, capability, loading metadata).
8 NN ;; Heading.
10 NN ;; Pointers to the framework and test-project rules.
12 NN ;; Heading.
14 OL [tst002.narrowest-level]
15 OL [tst003.behavior]
16 OL [tst006.waf]
17 OL [tst007.provider-fidelity]
19 NN ;; Heading.
21 OL [tst004.isolation]
22 OL [tst008.known-state]
24 NN ;; Heading.
26 OL [tst005.explicit-cases]
27 OL [tst012.names]
28 OL [tst011.no-low-value]
30 IM ;; Technique and procedure pointers.

C tst002.narrowest-level OL TST-002 DEFAULT ;; Narrowest meaningful test level; integration tests when wiring, HTTP, persistence, serialization or authentication is the subject; no fixed ratio. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst003.behavior OL TST-003 MUST ;; Tests verify observable behaviour, survive refactoring, do not test private calls or call sequences, do not reproduce the algorithm; interaction verification only when the interaction is the specified behaviour. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst006.waf OL TST-006 DEFAULT ;; WebApplicationFactory-based integration tests when routing, binding, middleware, auth, DI, repositories, persistence technology or database persistence must be proven. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst007.provider-fidelity OL TST-007 DEFAULT ;; Actual database provider when relational/provider behaviour matters (Testcontainers optional); never claim provider fidelity from a different provider. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst004.isolation OL TST-004 MUST ;; Tests are deterministic, order-independent and isolated from Production/Development data, uncontrolled external systems and shared mutable state. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst008.known-state OL TST-008 MUST ;; Tests start from a known state, own their setup and never depend on development seed data or test order. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst005.explicit-cases OL TST-005 DEFAULT ;; Small finite spaces use explicit declarative cases instead of loops, branches, LINQ or generated machinery; expected results are stated, not computed. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst012.names OL TST-012 DEFAULT ;; Descriptive test names (e.g. MethodOrScenario_Condition_ExpectedBehavior) unless the project has a convention. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst011.no-low-value OL TST-011 MUST_NOT ;; Must not generate low-value tests merely to increase coverage. ;; = ;; none ;;

@@ output/template/.claude/rules/frontend/frontend-framework.md ;; Path-scoped (frontend); frontend facet (angular).
@scope path-scoped: frontend/**/*
1-4 IM ;; Frontmatter path scope.
6 NN ;; Banner (kind, scope, capability, loading metadata).
8 NN ;; Heading.
10 OL [fe001.standalone-feature]
11 OL [fe004.signals-rxjs]
12 OL [fe008.interceptors]
13 OL [fe010.reactive-forms]
14 OL [fe011.no-nested-subscriptions]
15 OL [fe012.subscription-lifetime]
17 IM ;; Technique and enforced-by pointers.

C fe001.standalone-feature OL FE-001 DEFAULT ;; Modern standalone Angular APIs for new code (no new NgModules for ordinary features), organized primarily by feature. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe004.signals-rxjs OL FE-004 DEFAULT ;; Signals for synchronous local UI state; RxJS for async streams, HTTP composition, cancellation or event pipelines; avoid mechanical conversions. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe008.interceptors OL FE-008 DEFAULT ;; Functional HTTP interceptors for new code; interceptors stay cross-cutting and never contain feature business logic. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe010.reactive-forms OL FE-010 MUST ;; Reactive forms for non-trivial forms when useful; frontend validation is UX and never replaces backend validation or integrity/security enforcement. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe011.no-nested-subscriptions OL FE-011 DEFAULT ;; Avoid manual nested RxJS subscriptions; prefer composition operators. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe012.subscription-lifetime OL FE-012 MUST ;; Manual subscriptions from framework-managed code are tied to the component/service lifecycle with current Angular facilities (e.g. takeUntilDestroyed). ;; = ;; none ;;

@@ output/template/.claude/rules/frontend/frontend.md ;; Path-scoped (frontend).
@scope path-scoped: frontend/**/*
1-4 IM ;; Frontmatter path scope.
6 NN ;; Banner (kind, scope, capability, loading metadata).
8 NN ;; Heading.
10 NN ;; Pointer to the framework-specific rules.
12 NN ;; Heading.
14 OL [fe007.feature-structure]
15 OL [fe002.presentation-focus]
16 OL [fe005.lazy-loading]
17 OL [fe006.simple-state]
19 NN ;; Heading.
21 OL [fe003.data-access]
22 OL [fe009.error-contract]
24 IM ;; Technique pointer.

C fe007.feature-structure OL FE-007 MUST ;; Feature-oriented structure: no application-wide technical buckets or empty architecture folders; feature code stays in its feature; core/shared stay small. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe002.presentation-focus OL FE-002 MUST ;; Pages and components focus on presentation and UI orchestration; no moving trivial presentation logic into services merely to shrink components. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe005.lazy-loading OL FE-005 DEFAULT ;; Route-level lazy loading for meaningful features; not for every tiny component. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe006.simple-state OL FE-006 DEFAULT ;; Simple local, component or feature-service state before a state-management library. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe003.data-access OL FE-003 MUST ;; Backend communication lives in explicit feature data-access services or another HTTP boundary; never scattered HTTP calls; never backend Domain types in the frontend; frontend API models match the published contract. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe009.error-contract OL FE-009 MUST ;; Follow the documented API error contract; centralize ProblemDetails parsing when practical; never infer business behaviour from human-readable messages. ;; = ;; none ;;

@@ output/template/.claude/rules/frontend/security.md ;; Path-scoped (frontend).
@scope path-scoped: frontend/**/*
1-4 IM ;; Frontmatter path scope.
6 NN ;; Banner (kind, scope, capability, loading metadata).
8 NN ;; Heading.
10 OL [sec011.csrf]
11 OL [sec012.token-storage]

C sec011.csrf OL SEC-011 MUST ;; When browser cookies carry authentication automatically CSRF protection is part of the design; the SPA framework does not remove the risk; explicit Bearer headers differ. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec012.token-storage OL SEC-012 MUST_NOT ;; Never claim one browser token-storage mechanism is universally secure; choose by threat model; never log tokens. ;; = ;; none ;;
